task.summary: feat: add JWT authentication with registration and login endpoints
feat: implement authentication service with registration and login functionality - userstory finalisierung
feat: implement logout functionality with token revocation and session invalidation

feat(api): standardize API response envelope
Introduce a consistent ApiResponse envelope for JSON API responses, add public response DTOs, centralize error handling, and prevent passwordHash from being exposed in user responses.
Also update Auth/User/Pet controller responses, security error handling, OpenAPI documentation, HTTP client token extraction, and integration tests for success and error flows.

feat(api): standardize API response envelope
Introduce a consistent ApiResponse envelope for JSON API responses, add public response DTOs, centralize error handling, and prevent passwordHash from being exposed in user responses.
Also update Auth/User/Pet controller responses, security error handling, OpenAPI documentation, HTTP client token extraction, and integration tests for success and error flows.

feat(backend): add marketplace host overview and filters
- add marketplace endpoints for host listing, host search and dynamic filters - support filtering hosts by pet species and postal code - add host marketplace fields to users: postal code, city and accepted pet species - add marketplace response DTOs, service and repository queries - add HTTP request examples and OpenAPI documentation - add integration tests for host listing, search and filter options
Tests: - mvn test
